title: Released gas constant is air's, not hydrogen or the documented 10% H2 blend
evidence: Gas Properties (G) SID 4 in all six .slx: R = 0.287 kJ/kg/K (M ~ 29 g/mol); 10% H2/90% CH4 would be R ~ 0.57; H2 = 4.124
impact: Every released result describes an air-like gas; no hydrogen or blend claim is possible
proposed_correction: New model family H2Net v1 with real-gas hydrogen tables (S1)
alternatives: Semiperfect H2 tables (temperature-only); perfect-gas H2 constants
preferred_and_why: Real-gas tables: Z reaches 1.067 at 10 MPa, constant properties would misstate density by ~7%
acceptance_criteria: V1 passed (done); H2Net v1 built with tables and V2-V8 passed

title: Active perfect-gas constants physically impossible (gamma 5.75, Pr 0.079)
evidence: cp 0.3469, Z.R 0.2865 kJ/kg/K -> gamma = 5.75 > 5/3; Pr = 0.079; check_gas_properties fails the constants
impact: Compression heating, sound speed and heat transfer in released runs are unphysical (est. ~2,000 K compressor outlet)
proposed_correction: Replace with validated tables in H2Net v1; keep released simulator only as disclosed benchmark
preferred_and_why: H2Net v1: released files are not to be modified
acceptance_criteria: foundation.enum.gas_spec(1) == perfect recorded; H2Net v1 passes check_gas_properties

title: No hydrogen-methane mixture property model
evidence: No mixture tables, EOS or composition metadata exist; CoolProp installed only for pure H2
impact: Cross-gas objective O4 cannot be addressed
proposed_correction: Mixture real-gas tables from GERG-2008 (REFPROP/CoolProp mixtures) per composition; composition as model metadata
preferred_and_why: GERG-2008 is the standard natural-gas/H2 blend EOS
required_evidence_or_resource: GERG-2008 implementation with version; validation points

title: Adiabatic network (all pipes and chamber on Perfect Insulators)
evidence: Thermal ports of 7 pipes + chamber connect to perfect_insulator blocks
impact: Compression heat never removed; gas temperatures unrealistic
preferred_and_why: Convective model keeps transient thermal effects

title: Compressors are ideal isentropic pressure sources without efficiency, map or cooling
evidence: Pressure Source (G) SIDs 55, 239: power_spec isentropic; driven by PS Step / PS Ramp
impact: No physical mechanism for compressor faults/delays; unrealistic outlet temperatures
proposed_correction: Pressure-rise element + aftercooler, explicit fault parameterisation (S3)
preferred_and_why: Simplest physically consistent; maps need vendor data

title: Demand and leaks share the same atmospheric-orifice blocks
evidence: Restrictions G3-G6 (SIDs 213,222,312,215) = demand outlets AND leak sites; weak leaks settle onto NORMAL operating point
impact: Root of the weak-leak = NORMAL overlap; leak vs demand change not separable by design
proposed_correction: Demand as controlled mass-flow sinks; leaks as separate orifices at mid-pipe positions (S4)
preferred_and_why: Separating mechanisms makes the label physically meaningful
acceptance_criteria: No event uses a demand block; counterfactual pairs show event-only differences

title: Lumped 4-30 km pipes without inertia

preferred_and_why: Smallest change inside the existing toolchain
acceptance_criteria: V5 < 1% change on halving; V7 wave arrival
